reason: The hypothesis relies on specific claims about passive film formation, disruption, localized repassivation, and synergistic degradation in HEAs, but no prior evidence is cited to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the specific behaviour of HEAs under tribo-corrosion, so the lack of cited evidence leaves all key premises unsupported.
premises: HEA forms a stable passive oxide film in the corrosive medium
Mechanical wear disrupts the passive film, exposing fresh substrate
Exposed substrate corrodes rapidly and repassivates non-uniformly
Non-uniform repassivation creates weaker, brittle products that enhance wear
Synergy yields total degradation greater than sum of separate wear and corrosion
